question: In which year did Lala Hardayal form the Gadar Party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1913**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Ghadar Party was an international political movement consisting of expatriate Indians to overthrow British rule in India.
 
• The official founding date of the meeting was 15 July 1913 in Astoria, Oregon, with the headquarters of Ghadar and Hindustan Ghadar newspaper based in San Francisco, California.
 
• It was founded by Sohan Singh Bhakna and Lala Hardayal.
 
• Its aim was to get rid of the colonial super-power by means of an armed struggle and to set up a national democratic government on the sub-continent.
